notes.title: Stumble And Fall 1.0.0 Early Access Out NOW!
notes.content:
Stumble and fall early access has officially launched!

Prepare for chaotic fun with friends in this hilarious multiplayer brawler. Whether you're duking it out in intense battles or laughing at the absurdity of it all, Stumble And Fall promises endless entertainment.

Grab your buddies and join the mayhem today!

notes.title: Stumble And Fall 1.0.0 Launching Into Early Access May 10th!
notes.content:
On may 10th Stumble And Fall will be launching the first early access version!  The 1.0.0 game will include:

[u][b]Arena's[/b][/u]

-11 arena's for classic knockout game mode
-1 arena for "Topple" game mode

[u][b]Cosmetics[/b][/u]

-5 colours
-4 hats
-4 faces

[u][b]Weapons[/b][/u]

-sword
-hammer
-Bomb
-wooden bat
-TNT
-Traps

[u][b]Other[/b][/u]

-tutorial level


[b]much more content is to come in near updates such as:[/b]

-tons of cosmetics (unlockable for free)
-more arena's 
-new gamemodes

special thanks to all the people who have already wishlisted this game!
